name: San Giorgio Ionico (Italy)
description: Yellow field charged at the centre with the municipal arms of San Giorgio Ionico (Saint George on blue above a red star and two black birds on yellow).
history: Municipal flag of San Giorgio Ionico, a comune in Apulia; Italian municipal arms, gonfaloni and flags are granted by decree of the President of the Republic on the advice of the Government's heraldry office.

features.role: San Giorgio Ionico arms — Saint George on blue above a red star and two black birds on yellow
